title: Restarted scheduler did not treat an already-posted pick as locked: replayed the day's checks and would skip result polling (4/04)
missing_evidence: Pi5 scheduler output for the 2026-04-04 evening restarts (retention unknown; Pi5 decommissioned 4/14) showing a restarted instance replaying check times with the pick already posted and ending without result polling — Phase 2 Route R
the 2026-04-04 scheduler state (pick_locked, result_status) and which writer recorded the 4/04 result (scheduler polling vs the 1am cron) in B1
tier_reason: if it fired, the restarted instance re-ran the SSH cascade at every past check time and skipped result polling, leaving grading and the reply to the 1am cron; no firing is evidenced

contract.text: After a restart the scheduler resumes the day's state: a pick already posted counts as locked, lineup checks stop, and result polling runs.
contract.source: src/bts/scheduler.py run_day docstring steps 4–8 (7638af7); ARCHITECTURE.md at 4d12beb ('Short-circuit: if existing pick is already locked (game started or posted to Bluesky), skips the expensive SSH cascade entirely')

mechanism.text: run_day set state.pick_locked only when it posted the pick itself; a pick posted by an earlier instance or by hand came back from run_single_check as locked but left pick_locked False, so the loop kept running every check through the cascade and step 8 (result polling, gated on pick_locked) was skipped

residual.text: 823ccb3 still ran one full cascade before noticing the lock; 6d36adb (19:35 the same evening) short-circuited before the cascade

watchdog.trigger: after a scheduler (re)start on a day whose pick file shows a delivered pick, the state still has pick_locked False, or no result polling has started by the pick's first pitch + 30 min
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the restarted instance reports the pick locked, runs no new cascade for it, and records a result for the date

evidence.what: when a pick was posted by a previous instance (or manually), the restarted scheduler didn't set pick_locked, 'causing it to replay all check times and skip result polling'; no date or run is named
'today's debugging session' involved scheduler restarts ('saves ~3 min on every restart')
pick_locked is set only after the scheduler's own post; step 8 polls results only when pick_locked
